title: Women's AMI Text Graphic Cotton T-Shirt, Short Sleeve
intro:
Cotton crew-neck T-shirt with a bird and letter graphic, short sleeves and a pullover design. Available sizes are XS, S, M, L, XL, 2XL and 3XL, subject to the selected option.

CHOOSING YOUR SIZE
Measure a T-shirt that fits you comfortably. Lay it flat, measure from armpit to armpit and double that width to compare with Bust in the chart below. Also compare garment length and shoulder width. Select your preferred design or color first, then choose an available size. Measurements refer to the garment.
